title: 建築構造計画
subtitle: Structural Planning for Architecture
educationalGoal: Learn basic knowledge about building structures and materials, and develop the ability to show structural plans to plan and design mechanically rational building spaces.
advice: Learn the basics of structural planning to be safe from loads and external forces, and to select structural types, shapes, materials, and member arrangements from the mechanical standpoint that are suitable for the intended use of the building.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of Introduction of the structure (1st phase) and Structural Mechanics for Architecture Ⅰ (2nd term) and Ⅱ (3rd term) is required.

activityGoals.body: Explain the basic characteristics of structural materials and the features of structural systems.
Explain keywords important in structural planning.
The collapse load using the virtual work method can be calculated.
Explain the characteristics of loads and external forces and damage to buildings due to natural disasters.
Able to present seismic diagnosis and reinforcement of small houses.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1. Explain the structure of the building structure using specific examples. 2. Familiarize yourself with the role of the structural members and explain the effects of their arrangement on the structural system using mathematical formulas. 3. Present a safe and reasonable structural plan for existing wooden houses.
achievementLevels.standard: 1. Explain the structure of the building structure. 2. Explain the role of members and their influence on the structural system using a frame model. 3. Present a safe structural plan for existing wooden houses.
